title: Fairness Measures for Regression via Probabilistic Classification
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on algorithmic fairness, a core topic within AI ethics. It introduces and evaluates mathematical measures for fairness criteria (independence, separation, sufficiency) to address issues of inequity and unreasonable treatment in machine learning models. The work was presented at the 2nd Ethics of Data Science Conference, underscoring its direct engagement with ethical principles in data science.
